bookkeeper_added_checkpoints.why: The start-gate audit row lands in hedge_open_log and reaches the frontend through the legacy logs array, where extractHedgeAttempts (frontend/index.html:3835) treats any item carrying attempt_seq / pair_outcome / spot / perp as an attempt card. Verified by the bookkeeper: the designed payload (enabled / previous_enabled / version / source) carries none of those keys, so isHedgeAttemptShaped rejects it. That is an implicit dependency, so both sides must pin it.
bookkeeper_added_checkpoints.backend_obligation: assert the start_gate_changed payload key set is exactly those four and disjoint from the attempt-shape keys
bookkeeper_added_checkpoints.frontend_obligation: assert extractHedgeAttempts returns empty for a start_gate_changed log entry

bookkeeper_added_checkpoints.why: frontend/self-check.js carries 14 'hgo-' client_order_id literals as display-only mock fixtures. The backend derivation changes to hg{uuid}s|p this round. The design mentions only the 18 backend/tests literals, so the frontend ones were unassigned.
bookkeeper_added_checkpoints.resolution: They are arbitrary arguments and need not change; if the frontend implementer changes them it must be done consistently across all 14. The backend is told not to touch them. The choice must be stated in the frontend report.

rationale: All five scope items are defect repairs and hardening inside the direction already frozen and approved for 2026-07-hedge-open-real-api-v1; no new product direction is introduced.
Work spans backend and frontend and touches a live-risk control surface (S3 Start gate write path), so it is not LOW and needs a development breakdown plus both review gates.
The user explicitly approved the lightweight route on 2026-07-27.

S1.title: clientOrderId exceeds Binance's 36-char cap
S1.blocking: No real order can currently succeed.

S2.title: A freshly created card cannot be started in live mode

S3.title: The Start gate has no operator entry point

user_decision.detail: Backend gains a write path for the durable Start gate; the frontend drives both directions from one control, each requiring exactly one confirmation dialog. No typed confirmation word and no asymmetry between on and off. The design must still specify concurrency safety using the existing settings version column and keep the gate closed by default on a fresh install.

S4.title: Display worker_active / last_worker_exit_reason; validate spot+perp both exist at card creation

S5.title: Offline transport must enforce known Binance parameter constraints (length, charset, precision)
S5.rationale: Direct root cause of S1 escaping nine review rounds.
